title: Evaluation Brain independent of the Model Foundry
statement: The component that judges a model or strategy (Evaluation Brain) is separate from the component that creates it (Strategy/Model Foundry), so the creator of an idea is never its sole judge.
rationale: Self-graded ideas: the creator scoring its own candidates promotes overfit work.

verification.check: Promotion decisions are taken by code with no dependency on the generator's scoring; a mutation that lets the generator's own score promote fails an architecture test.

title: Every path, including paths not taken, becomes training data
statement: Every decision path, including declined, unfilled and alternative paths, is captured as a learning record.
rationale: Learning only from executed paths biases the platform toward its own gates.

verification.check: A cycle that declines an order produces a counterfactual learning record; deleting the declined capture makes the test fail.

title: Outcome attribution by strategy, model, belief, source, policy, rule, path
statement: Each outcome is attributed by strategy, model, belief, evidence source, capital policy, risk rule and execution path.
rationale: An unattributed outcome cannot tell the platform which component to credit or blame.

verification.check: An attribution record carries all seven keys for a fill; dropping one key fails the test.

notes: 'Live' outcome is paper-trading outcome under ADR 0003.

title: Counterfactual replay for declined, partial, hedged and unwound paths
statement: Counterfactual replay is run for declined, partially filled, hedged and unwound opportunities.
rationale: A veto or partial fill whose alternative is never priced cannot be judged protective or merely expensive.

verification.check: For each of the four path kinds, LEARN produces a counterfactual set; removing one kind's queue fails its test.

title: Champion/challenger with regime-conditioned scorecards
statement: Models and strategies are run as champion/challenger with scorecards conditioned on regime.
rationale: A global score hides a challenger that wins in one regime and loses in another.

verification.check: A challenger ahead in one regime and behind in another is reported split and registered only in the regime where it leads.

title: Data-source alpha attribution after cost and delay
statement: For each data source, measure whether it improved decisions after its cost and its delay.
rationale: Paying for a source that duplicates another or arrives too late.

verification.check: A duplicate source scores near-zero gain; a late source's contribution is discounted by its delay; a costly one by cost.

title: Quantum-vs-classical benchmark per workload family and instance size
statement: Each quantum-vs-classical comparison is recorded keyed by workload family and instance size.
rationale: A quantum claim not grouped by problem kind and size cannot be checked against its baseline (ADR 0006).

verification.check: A cycle that sizes a proposal publishes one SolverBenchmarked record keyed by family and size matching its journal entry.

title: Automatic retirement of degraded models and strategies
statement: Models and strategies that degrade are retired automatically, without a human call.
rationale: A decayed strategy keeps trading because nobody got round to retiring it.

verification.check: Sustained decay at the floor retires the strategy and journals its disposition; a drifted model is retired.

title: Rollback to last known-good artifact
statement: On retirement, the platform rolls back to the last known-good artifact.
rationale: Retiring a degraded artifact with nothing to fall back to leaves the slot empty or worse.

verification.check: A degraded model's predecessor returns at the digest that passed; a rollback with no known-good predecessor is refused.

title: Research prompts from failure clusters and unexplained residuals
statement: Closed-loop research prompts are generated from clusters of failures and from unexplained residuals.
rationale: Repeated misses charged to a track record and forgotten.

verification.check: A cluster of failed theses raises one prompt; an unexplained residual above threshold raises one too.

title: Novelty and knowledge-gap detection
statement: Detect unexplained residuals, low-confidence regions, contradictory evidence, missing causal links, unsupported asset classes and capabilities with no competent specialist.
rationale: Ignorance that is never named is never researched.

verification.check: Each of the six gap kinds is raised by a detector over platform state; deleting a detector fails its test.

title: Regional reflex episodes become globally shareable
statement: Microstructure drift, local failures, missed fills, queue behaviour and venue anomalies at a regional cell become globally shareable episodes.
rationale: Lessons trapped in one region.

verification.check: An episode recorded at a cell reaches the central learning store; a cell-only buffer fails the test.

title: Memory consolidation and compression keeps learning bounded
statement: Preserve high-value episodes and abstractions while deduplicating stale detail so memory growth stays bounded.
rationale: Unbounded memory becoming noise.

verification.check: At capacity, a high-grade episode survives and a stale duplicate is evicted; abstraction records are produced from clusters.

title: Tick-learning loop reconciles live fills against replay assumptions
statement: Fills, slippage, queue errors, missed/expired opportunities and book-regime changes are reconciled against replay assumptions and become microstructure retraining/evaluation data.
rationale: A twin whose fill assumptions drift from reality without anyone noticing.

verification.check: A fill whose price differs from the twin's assumption is charted and enters a retraining dataset.

title: World-market reaction loop over multiple horizons
statement: Each material world event is paired with the observed multi-asset/tick response over multiple horizons, and these reaction episodes update causal propagation models.
rationale: Not learning when markets ignore, anticipate or overreact.

verification.check: An event yields reaction records at several horizons and a contradicting reaction lowers a causal edge's confidence.

title: Every forecast and model is scored after resolution
statement: Every forecast, world model, specialist and ensemble is scored after its outcome resolves.
rationale: Forecasts never checked against outcomes cannot be trusted.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A resolved thesis is graded and charged to its component; an unresolved one is not.

title: Probability calibration tracked per forecaster
statement: The platform tracks probability calibration for each forecaster.
rationale: Seventy-percent calls that come true half the time.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A resolving cycle moves the calibration series; mutation removing the call leaves it unchanged and fails.

title: Directional and quantile accuracy tracked
statement: Directional and quantile accuracy are tracked for each forecaster.
rationale: A forecaster right on direction but wrong on spread is sized as if calibrated.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: Quantile (pinball) loss is computed per forecaster on resolution.

title: Forecast tail performance tracked
statement: Tail performance of each forecaster is tracked.
rationale: A forecaster good on average and catastrophic in the tails.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A forecaster that misses only tail outcomes scores worse on the tail metric than one that does not.

title: Incremental information value per forecaster
statement: The incremental information value each forecaster adds is tracked.
rationale: Paying for forecasters that only repeat each other.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A forecaster duplicating another scores near-zero incremental value.

title: Economic contribution and downstream capital impact per forecaster
statement: Economic contribution and downstream capital impact are attributed to each forecaster.
rationale: Accuracy that never translated to P&L is mistaken for value.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A forecaster's attributed P&L equals the sum over the positions it informed.

title: Internal synthetic capital determines model influence and compute
statement: An internal synthetic capital/reputation ledger (internal prediction market) determines each model's future influence and compute allocation.
rationale: Influence and compute allocated by habit instead of earned track record.

sources.section: §22.1 Forecast Scoreboard, Internal Prediction Market & Economic Attribution

verification.check: A model whose synthetic capital falls loses weight in the next decision and compute share; a mutation fixing weights fails.

title: New capability evaluated, sandboxed, lineage-tracked, gate-promoted
statement: Every new capability (knowledge, ontology, memory, specialist, tool, model, research) is evaluated, sandboxed, lineage-tracked and promoted only through explicit gates; no uncontrolled self-modification.
rationale: Open-ended growth turning into uncontrolled self-modification.

verification.check: Each capability kind has a registry whose only widening path cites an evaluation.

title: Expansion engine sits above the brains, off the decision path
statement: The expansion engine reads the brains and nothing below a composition root depends on it, so a stalled curriculum cannot stall a cycle.
rationale: A research queue becoming a dependency of the thing that decides.

verification.check: An acceptance test fails if any non-app crate depends on qip-expansion.

title: Convert ignorance into research work and proven research into capability
statement: The expansion engine converts ignorance, surprise and failure into structured research work, then converts proven research into deployable capability.
rationale: Research that never closes onto capability; surprises that never become research.

verification.check: A raised gap becomes a queued item, and a closed item produces a promoted capability record.

rationale: Capability growth with no typed artifact cannot be evaluated, lineage-tracked or rolled back.

verification.check: A SourceSpec / FeedPack record is produced by the mechanism, validated, and carries lineage; deleting the producing call fails the test.

verification.check: A pure-novelty candidate never outranks one with economic value and information gain.

rationale: Curiosity driven only by human questions misses what nobody thought to ask.

verification.check: The trigger condition yields exactly one queued item naming its origin.

rationale: Curiosity driven only by human questions misses what nobody thought to ask.

verification.check: The trigger condition yields exactly one queued item naming its origin.

title: Self-improvement never mutates production control or money path in place
statement: Proposed code, tools, agents, features, schemas and models move through isolated branch/sandbox, reproducible tests, security and data-policy checks, simulation/replay, independent evaluation, shadow/paper operation and signed promotion; nothing mutates the production control plane or money-moving path in place.
rationale: An agent editing the live path in place with no review.

verification.check: Deployed images are only those signed/attested by CI; models reach production only through registry stages.

title: Evidence and rollback requirements scale with authority
statement: The more authority a capability receives, the stronger its evidence and rollback requirements.
rationale: Broad authority granted on thin evidence.

verification.check: Widening authority without the stronger evidence is refused.

title: New tools default to read-only, sandboxed permissions
statement: New tools start read-only/sandboxed until their behaviour and data handling are understood.
rationale: A new tool with write or network authority from day one.

verification.check: A newly registered tool holds only Read; LeaveSandbox requires a promotion citing an evaluation.

title: New specialists declare competency boundaries and abstain outside them
statement: Each new specialist declares its competency boundary and abstains outside it.
rationale: A specialist answering confidently outside its domain.

verification.check: A manifest without a competency boundary is refused; a question outside it yields a Deferred finding that downstream does not weight.

title: New model must beat a named baseline and stay calibrated under stress
statement: A new model must beat a named baseline on a declared benchmark and remain calibrated under stress/regime shift.
rationale: Promoting a model that only looks good in one regime.

verification.check: A candidate without a calibrated baseline on record is refused; one miscalibrated under a stressed regime is refused.

title: Reflex artifacts meet deterministic resource, latency, failure budgets
statement: A new reflex artifact must meet deterministic resource, latency and failure-mode budgets before regional deployment.
rationale: A reflex artifact that blows the cell's latency or memory budget in production.

verification.check: A student whose step cost, memory or failure-mode budget is exceeded is refused before it can be shipped to a cell.

title: Promoted capability keeps full lineage and rollback parent
statement: Every promoted capability keeps lineage to its research campaign, datasets, code, model, evaluations and rollback parent.
rationale: An artifact nobody can trace or undo.

verification.check: A promotion without any lineage field is refused.

title: Capability receives authority only after measurable value
statement: New capability must demonstrate measurable value before receiving authority; expansion stays bounded by capital, compute, data rights, regulation and security.
rationale: Authority granted on promise rather than measurement.

verification.check: Each authority-widening path requires a measured-value record.

title: Agency engine between cognition and tool execution
statement: The Causal Agency & Intervention Engine sits between cognition and tool execution, turning desired outcomes into testable, policy-constrained causal action plans and turning action results back into learned causal structure.
rationale: Prediction treated as agency, or actions with no causal learning.

verification.check: A request flows goal -> plan -> gate -> shadow, and an attributed result updates the causal structure.

title: Desired outcome is a typed GoalSpec with all declarations
statement: A desired outcome is a typed GoalSpec declaring target state/distribution, entities affected, time horizon, success metric, acceptable uncertainty, budget, risk envelope, legal/jurisdictional boundary, acting identity, prohibited side effects and stop/rollback conditions.
rationale: A free-form goal carries no budget, envelope or identity to stay inside.

verification.check: A goal missing any one declaration is refused naming that field; a document missing a field is refused on deserialisation, not defaulted.

title: Goals cover eight objective classes
statement: Goals may be financial, operational, research, product, liquidity, risk-reduction, information-acquisition or communications objectives.
rationale: An objective class with no representation is forced into the wrong one.

verification.check: A goal of each of the eight classes round-trips through serde unchanged.

title: Outcome preference never implies action permission
statement: Wanting an outcome never implies permission to use every causal lever that might achieve it; each lever requires authority the acting identity independently holds.
rationale: A planner treating a goal's utility as licence.

verification.check: A plan using a lever whose authority the identity lacks is refused whatever its effect.

title: Action-affordance graph extends the world model federation
statement: The World Model Federation is extended with an action-affordance graph recording which variables can be observed and controlled, which tools affect them, expected latency/cost, causal paths, side effects, dependencies and authority requirements.
rationale: A planner picking a lever nobody can pull from an observational graph.

verification.check: A tool edge missing a declaration or on an observable-only variable is refused; levers are only controllable variables with a tool edge.

title: Symbolic hard constraints; learned models estimate effect sizes
statement: Symbolic reasoning enforces hard constraints while learned causal models estimate uncertain effect sizes; no estimate outweighs a constraint.
rationale: A large expected effect buying its way past a constraint.

verification.check: No learned effect estimate however large gets a plan past a hard constraint.

title: Interventions modelled as do(action) with counterfactual branches
statement: Interventions are represented with structural causal models and counterfactual branches: do(action) -> intermediate states -> target outcome.
rationale: Correlation mistaken for control.

verification.check: An intervention's effect is computed by graph surgery, distinct from the observational association.

title: Weak identification leads to abstain, gather evidence or experiment
statement: When causal identification is weak, the engine abstains, gathers more evidence or proposes an experiment rather than acting.
rationale: Pretending correlation is control.

verification.check: A plan pulling a weakly identified lever is never returned for execution.

title: Candidate set always includes a no-action baseline
statement: Every candidate set includes exactly one no-action baseline against which actions are judged.
rationale: Acting when doing nothing was better.

verification.check: A candidate set without exactly one baseline and one alternative is refused; an effect not strictly positive loses to no action.

title: Planner generates multiple candidate action sequences
statement: The planner itself generates multiple candidate action sequences for a goal.
rationale: A planner that only evaluates what an operator thought of.

verification.check: Given a goal and graph with no proposals, the planner produces at least two admissible candidates.

title: Simulate candidates across world models, twins and scenarios
statement: Each candidate is simulated across competing world models, market/tick digital twins and scenario branches.
rationale: A plan judged against a single assumed world.

verification.check: A candidate's simulation produces one result per world model and twin scenario.

title: Candidates compared on nine declared axes
statement: Candidates are compared on expected causal effect, confidence, cost, capital usage, time-to-effect, reversibility, legal eligibility, conduct risk and downside.
rationale: Ranking that silently omits downside or conduct risk.

verification.check: A comparison missing any axis is refused; changing conduct risk or downside changes the ranking.

title: Plans may be parallel, sequential, conditional or adaptive
statement: Candidate interventions can be parallel, sequential, conditional or adaptive, with bounds held against every branch.
rationale: A conditional branch that would breach the budget hidden by checking only the branch that fires.

verification.check: A conditional runs only when its condition holds; an adaptive switches; a bound is checked against every branch.

title: Action only through registered tools with identity, permission, audit
statement: The platform acts only through registered tools with explicit identities, permissions and audit.
rationale: An adapter invoked before anyone declared who it acts as.

verification.check: An unregistered tool or one without identity is refused and every decision audited; the only adapter caller checks the registry.

title: Truthful publishing and communications surface
statement: Attributable articles, research notes, disclosures, reports or posts through authorised channels with source lineage, factuality checks, disclosure policy and immutable audit.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Authorised stakeholder outreach surface
statement: Messages, requests for information, customer/vendor/partner engagement or negotiation through approved identities and channels.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Research action surface
statement: Acquire lawful data, run surveys/experiments where permitted, request additional evidence, launch simulations or commission a specialist research campaign.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Product and pricing action surface
statement: Adjust Algorik-controlled product configuration, pricing, availability or service behaviour where governance permits.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Operational action surface
statement: Routing, logistics, inventory, compute, deployment, scheduling, sourcing and other owned-system changes.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Capital and risk action surface
statement: Allocate, hedge, rebalance, reserve liquidity, move collateral or reduce exposure within signed authority envelopes.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Market and product action surface
statement: Quote, provide liquidity, create/list/seed markets or instruments, or execute commerce/trading actions subject to venue, jurisdiction and conduct controls.
rationale: An action surface used without registered identity, permission and audit.

verification.check: The surface's adapter exists only behind registered tool identity, permission, audit and the paper boundary.

notes: One bullet of §24.4's action-surface list. Platform rules refuse external action; scored accordingly.

title: Communications & Conduct Brain checks seven dimensions
statement: Before any external communication, check factual support, provenance, identity, required disclosures, audience/channel permissions, jurisdiction and whether the pattern could constitute deceptive coordination or manipulation.
rationale: Communication used as an exemption from evidence and conduct rules.

verification.check: A draft failing any one check is blocked; each check independently enforced.

title: Deceptive and manipulative techniques are never used
statement: The platform never uses fabricated identities, sockpuppets, bots posing as people, fake consensus, false/misleading claims, undisclosed paid promotion, rumour manufacture, wash trading, spoofing, pump-and-dump or other deceptive techniques to move prices or beliefs.
rationale: Market manipulation and deceptive coordination.

verification.check: No tool edge of a deceptive method reaches a plan; the order path refuses a self-trade.

title: A plan that depends on deception is infeasible
statement: If a causal plan depends on deception, the plan is infeasible whatever its expected effect.
rationale: A large expected effect justifying a deceptive step.

verification.check: A plan with a deceptive step anywhere in it is refused for every generated effect estimate.

title: Post-intervention causal effect estimated by identified methods
statement: After an intervention the Evaluation Brain estimates the caused change using randomised/staged experiments where feasible, else matched/synthetic controls, difference-in-differences, instrumental/structural methods, Bayesian causal models, counterfactual branches and no-action baselines.
rationale: Crediting an action with what would have happened anyway.

verification.check: Each method produces an estimate with an identification label; none exists without one.

title: Correlation never upgraded to causal certainty
statement: The platform records uncertainty and never upgrades correlation into causal certainty without evidence.
rationale: Authority widened on a forecast that merely came true.

verification.check: A NotIdentified attribution never widens a policy.

title: Effect attribution multi-horizon with chain and rivals
statement: Effects are measured at multiple horizons, and the attribution preserves the causal chain, confounders, competing explanations and confidence rather than a final KPI.
rationale: A bare KPI change that cannot be audited.

verification.check: An attribution without chain, confounders, rivals, confidence or horizon observations is refused.

title: Ambient signals reach agency only via Attention Router and gates
statement: Ambient models may surface a DesiredOutcome or ActionOpportunity, which never directly causes action: the Attention Router sends it to the Agency Brain, which builds a GoalSpec and candidates, runs simulation and policy/conduct gates and obtains the required authority.
rationale: An ambient signal acting on the world unreviewed.

verification.check: An ambient opportunity produces a GoalSpec and a gated, shadowed plan and no adapter call.

title: Agency loop runs in declared order end to end
statement: The loop is observe -> predict -> specify desired state -> identify levers -> generate -> simulate -> verify authority/conduct -> act -> observe -> attribute -> update world models, policies and priors.
rationale: An action before simulation, or an attribution before its action.

verification.check: A stage is admitted only in order and never after a failure; the full eleven stages complete on one pass.

title: Action Outcome Memory records nine fields
statement: An Action Outcome Memory records intervention context, audience/environment state, action sequence, causal hypothesis, predicted effect, actual observations, attribution confidence, side effects and no-action counterfactual.
rationale: Learning to repeat whatever coincided with a KPI rise.

sources.section: §24.8 What the System Learns About Agency

verification.check: A record missing any of the nine is refused and not remembered.

title: Learn which actions work, for whom, when, with what delay
statement: From the memory the platform learns which actions work, for whom, under which regimes, with what delay, and when not acting is better.
rationale: Repeating an action that only worked elsewhere.

sources.section: §24.8 What the System Learns About Agency

verification.check: recommend picks an action where it measurably worked and none where it did not, per environment state.

title: ForecastState contract: typed multi-horizon prediction
statement: A typed ForecastState contract (typed multi-horizon prediction) carries target, horizon, distribution, confidence, epistemic/aleatoric uncertainty, expiry, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A ForecastState missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: WorldBranch contract: one plausible future
statement: A typed WorldBranch contract (one plausible future) carries parent branch, assumptions, probability, causal deltas, unresolved evidence, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A WorldBranch missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: InformationRequest contract: active sensing request
statement: A typed InformationRequest contract (active sensing request) carries question, expected information value, deadline, allowed sources, budget, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A InformationRequest missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: ModelVote contract: model-tournament prediction
statement: A typed ModelVote contract (model-tournament prediction) carries model/version, probability, regime, score history, compute cost, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A ModelVote missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: ComputePlan contract: hybrid compute routing
statement: A typed ComputePlan contract (hybrid compute routing) carries task, classical baseline, CPU/GPU/TPU/QPU candidates, budget, verifier, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A ComputePlan missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: HedgePlan contract: portfolio protection plan
statement: A typed HedgePlan contract (portfolio protection plan) carries exposures, scenarios protected, instruments, cost, liquidity, rollback, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A HedgePlan missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: CapitalGrant contract: bounded deployable authority
statement: A typed CapitalGrant contract (bounded deployable authority) carries amount, strategy, region, venue, risk budget, liquidity reserve, expiry, refusing a record missing any field.
rationale: Brains exchanging untyped state cannot be audited or replayed.

verification.check: A CapitalGrant missing any of its fields is refused on decode; a round-trip is byte-identical.

title: Eligibility metadata on venue, product, user, jurisdiction, strategy
statement: Technical capability and legal permission are separate dimensions: every venue, product, user/entity, jurisdiction and strategy carries eligibility metadata.
rationale: Assuming one legal entity may do everything it can technically do.

verification.check: Each of the five subject kinds has an eligibility record and an absent record refuses.

title: Cognition may analyse what execution may not do
statement: The cognitive core may evaluate an opportunity or intervention that the execution layer, acting identity, entity, channel or jurisdiction is not permitted to perform.
rationale: Either refusing to think about forbidden actions or letting analysis imply permission.

verification.check: An out-of-scope opportunity routes to a shadow record with no path to an intent; an unauthorised intervention is analysed and reported refused.

title: Jurisdiction/product eligibility gate before deployment and new venue
statement: A jurisdiction/product eligibility gate runs before strategy deployment and before every new venue or instrument becomes executable.
rationale: Trading a product or venue the entity is not permitted to.

verification.check: Deploying a strategy or enabling a venue/instrument without an eligible record is refused.

title: Separate identities and credentials per regulated function
statement: Trading, custody/transfer, market creation, banking/financing and commerce purchasing each use separate identities and credentials.
rationale: One credential compromise spanning every regulated function.

verification.check: Each function's credential is a distinct secret readable only by the process using it.

title: Signed authority envelopes for destinations, leverage, products, functions
statement: Human-signed or governance-signed authority envelopes govern destinations, leverage, product classes and regulated functions.
rationale: Authority taken rather than granted.

verification.check: An envelope without a valid signature over every bound is refused; widening requires a new signed envelope.

title: Immutable audit of model, data, policy, code and control versions
statement: Each decision has an immutable audit of the model, data, policy, code and control versions involved.
rationale: A decision that cannot be reproduced because nobody recorded what produced it.

verification.check: A decision record carries all five version identifiers and sits in the hash-chained log; dropping one fails a replay test.

title: Unsupported opportunities remain shadow-only
statement: Research/simulation may be broader than executable scope, and unsupported opportunities remain shadow-only however they are rescored.
rationale: A rescore promoting an out-of-scope opportunity to an action.

verification.check: An opportunity outside the scope stays shadow however it is rescored.

title: Action tool registration declares six attributes and revocation
statement: Every action tool has a registered acting identity, permission scope, disclosure policy, audience/channel rules, rate/budget limits and revocation path.
rationale: A tool that can act before anyone said how to stop it.

verification.check: A registration missing any field is refused; after revocation the next call is refused and audited.

title: Goal approval, plan approval and execution separately auditable
statement: Goal approval, plan approval and action execution are three separately auditable records.
rationale: An approval that cannot be attributed to the person who gave it.

verification.check: One intervention leaves three linked records each with its own actor and time; out-of-order timestamps are refused.

title: Sensitive intervention classes require stronger approval
statement: Sensitive intervention classes can require stronger approval than ordinary research.
rationale: A communication or capital action approved at research authority.

verification.check: A capital-class intent with only operational authority is refused; with capital authority admitted.

title: Market-facing actions cross-checked for manipulation risk
statement: Public communications and market-facing actions are cross-checked for market-conduct/manipulation risk.
rationale: Manipulation through a channel nobody reviewed.

verification.check: A market-facing action matching a manipulation pattern is refused before any adapter.

title: Profit or price impact alone never justifies an action
statement: Public communications and market-facing actions cannot be justified solely by expected profit or desired price impact.
rationale: Price impact as a motive becoming manipulation.

verification.check: A justification of only profit and/or price impact is refused; one with an evidence ground is admitted.
